task: Activate the shared nominal key proof for staged Map and Set operations.
observation: The existing staged nominal Map proof validator ran after effect inference but before main-body checking. A nominal key used only in main therefore passed moss check even without isequal/hash; the generated backend would have failed later. Moving validation after all body checks makes the same missing-proof Map and Set probes fail with KEY_PROOF_INVALID.
impact: The negative fixture exposed a checker admission hole and prevented relying on native compiler failure as proof validation.
evidence: tests/phase25/key_protocol/06h-proof-missing/case.moss: staged check initially passed and now reports KEY_PROOF_INVALID
src/moss.cpp: Checker::run validates staged nominal keys after main and test bodies
tmp/set-stage/missing-set-proof.moss: staged Set probe reports KEY_PROOF_INVALID

resolution.summary: Run nominal key-proof validation after body checking, when all key uses have been registered; confirm malformed and impure proofs fail closed.

task: Validate an ABI-v10 nominal key proof with the provider source removed.
observation: Margo build of a path-dependent consumer attempted to rebuild the provider after its source was removed and stopped with PROJECT_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, even though the provider's sealed .mossi and selected rlib were present. The repository compiler's moss build resolved the same artifacts through MOSS_MODULE_PATH, checked the proof, and ran the consumer natively.
impact: Source-free integration needs the compiler build path or a Margo dependency mode that accepts compiled providers; a normal Margo path dependency is not sufficient evidence for compiled-only behavior.
evidence: tests/phase25/key_protocol/test_proof_transport.py exercises moss check/build with provider source hidden and MOSS_MODULE_PATH set
MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 margo build --json in copied 03 app returned PROJECT_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND for keyprov/src after source removal

resolution.summary: Use moss build for the source-free acceptance probe; Margo compiled-provider dependency support is a separate ecosystem question.

task: Activate source-backed nominal Map parity in Fast Debug and native engines.
observation: The activated fixture runner stopped Fast Debug at a nominal Map index read after printing the key count, while native debug and release completed correctly. The interpreter's general Map lookup used key-protocol equality, but its lvalue-shaped locate path still used ordinary structural equality for the same index expression.
impact: A fixture that compared only Map.get would miss the divergent index path; the full source-backed fixture exposed it before activation.
evidence: MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 tests/phase25/key_protocol/run_fixtures.py --observe 03-imported-nominal-keys reported Fast Debug missing map key at line 11 after stdout 2
src/interpreter_domains.inc locate Map index now uses protocol_key_equal

resolution.summary: Use the same key-protocol equality for interpreter lvalue-shaped Map lookup as other Map operations.
